description: Press the mouse on a circle and drag it round to another angle, releasing there. For rotation dials and radial controls that respond to absolute angle from their centre, not to a click. Drives the real pointer in small continuous moves, so the widget sees every intermediate angle (when the control re-checks on movement, the end angle alone is not enough). Angles: 0° = 3 o’clock, 90° = 6 o’clock, 180° = 9 o’clock, positive = clockwise.

centerX.description: Centre x (used when elementUUID is omitted)

centerY.description: Centre y (used when elementUUID is omitted)

direction.description: Which way round to travel: shortest (default), or forced clockwise / counter-clockwise.

elementUUID.description: Circular control to use as the centre (its box centre)

endAngle.description: Angle to release at, degrees, same convention.

handleUUID.description: Grab knob/handle element. The press starts at its box centre and its current angle from the centre becomes the start angle, so only endAngle is needed. Overrides radius for the grab point.

holdAtEndMs.description: Pause with the button still down at the end angle before releasing (default 60)

radius.description: Distance from the centre to grab at, in px. Default: 75% of the control’s half-size, so the grab lands on the rim.

startAngle.description: Angle to press at, degrees. 0 = 3 o’clock, 90 = 6 o’clock, 180 = 9 o’clock (clockwise). Default: the handle’s current angle, or 0 without a handleUUID.

stepDelayMs.description: Pause between moves, ms (default 16 ≈ one frame)

steps.description: Intermediate moves (default ≈ one per 2° of travel, min 24, max 180)

name: playwright_drag_arc
